subject: Operations
title: Statistical Process Control
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Statistical Process Control.

hook.text: A filling machine targets 500 ml. Today's output averages 503. Is that a problem? SPC tells you in seconds.

buildup.text: SPC uses control charts to track output over time. If data stays between control limits, the process is stable.

discovery.text: Points outside the limits signal something changed. Investigate before defects pile up.

twist.text: SPC catches drift in real time instead of waiting for finished products to fail inspection.

climax.text: Factories using SPC reduce scrap rates by 30–50% because they correct problems before defects accumulate.

punchline.text: Watch the chart. Catch the drift. Save the batch.

quiz.question: What happens when data falls outside control limits?
